summary.text: Brett Mohler is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 26, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Austin Harris.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary, and Ballotpedia lists the Iowa Federation of Labor, AFL-CIO among his endorsements.
